Name: GetCategoryProducts
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: GetCategoryProducts, command: many)
SELECT
  category,
  GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY name ASC) AS sorted_names,
  GROUP_CONCAT(name, ',' ORDER BY price DESC) AS by_price
FROM products
GROUP BY category;
